finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new bundler sends `retryCount`. It now takes either name.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. Unset now means off, like before.

The 8 remaining warnings are deprecation notices. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js`, which this project does not contain.
